rubric_content.text_property: The agent must demonstrate accurate understanding of the document layout, especially for complex or nested tables. Penalize if the agent misinterprets the relationship between headers and data, or if it misses structural components identified in the layout analysis phase.

The agent must delegate the query to the most appropriate specialized sub-agent based on the user's intent. Penalize if the agent attempts to answer a complex domain-specific query itself when a dedicated sub-agent is available, or if it routes to an irrelevant sub-agent.

extraction_f1.description: Per-field F1 over extracted key/value pairs, compared by value. Deterministic and free: no judge model. Partial credit, so finding nine of ten fields scores better than finding none.

schema_adherence.description: 1.0 when the response parses as StructuredResponse with every field populated. Replaces the LLM schema_fidelity rubric with an exact check.
